---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  group_by(Activity) |>
  filter(n() >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  ungroup() |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Activity, y = n, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Activity", y = "Number of attacks", fill = "Outcome")
```
